tools.name: import_media_to_timeline
tools.description: Import a host-local video, audio, image or model file through Powermove's media importer. Requires project access. Returns asset/layer IDs; optional at places it in the timeline. Hidden hosts support this without any file picker.

sequence.description: Import an image sequence (File > Import Image Sequence): path is its folder or one of its numbered files; one clip reads its frames in place at fps.

tools.name: replace_media
tools.description: Replace or relink one existing media asset from an absolute local file path. Preserves its asset ID, all timeline references, timing, animation and folder. Uses durable storage and normal editor Undo; never packages bytes into an extension or opens a file picker. Requires the same media kind and unlocked referencing layers. missingOnly skips available assets; expectedFingerprint verifies file identity against list_media. Returns verified persisted status; errors leave the original unchanged. Retry individual failed assets, never repeat successful replacements. Media actions use editor Undo, not rollback_changes. Local files up to 512 MiB; download cloud files first.

sequence.description: Import an image sequence (File > Import Image Sequence): path is its folder or one of its numbered files; one clip reads its frames in place at fps.

tools.name: import_media
tools.description: Import a local media file into durable project media without adding timeline layers or packaging bytes into extension code. Supply an absolute path, optional folderId and expectedFingerprint. Returns assetId and verified persisted status; already imported matching bytes are reused. Place the asset with apply_commands/edit_video. Import survives timeline Undo, like normal imports; use manage_media delete to remove it. Local files up to 512 MiB; download cloud files first.
